name: Marisol Vega, RN, BSN
summary: Med-surg nurse with nine years in nursing, the last seven on a 32-bed unit, often the resource nurse on nights. Ready to take on charge responsibilities in the ICU.

experience.title: Registered Nurse, Med-Surg
bullets: Care for 5-6 patients per shift on a 32-bed medical-surgical unit with telemetry.
Charge nurse relief about twice a month: assign patients, manage admissions and escalate to the house supervisor.
Precepted 11 new graduate nurses; 10 finished orientation on schedule.
Led the unit's fall-prevention project; falls per 1,000 patient days dropped from 3.1 to 1.9 in a year.

experience.title: Staff Nurse
bullets: Provided patient care on a 28-bed orthopedic floor
Taught discharge education to patients and families
Floated to the telemetry unit when short-staffed

certifications: RN, New Mexico Board of Nursing, active
